name: tpl-precedence-3-nogoal
task: Do not take the key until you have moved the ball away from the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a restriction — taking the key is forbidden until the ball is moved. Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard expresses exactly that; has_door_key is only restricted, not commanded, so the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: If the agent ever has the door key, then the blocker has been moved at some point: whenever has_door_key happens, blocker_moved must have happened before or at that time.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, blocker_moved) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&has_door_key, u1) -> -10
